from echo_sync.speech_text import _Engine

def test_course_code_before():
    # "МДК.03.01" -> tokens: 0:"МДК"(word), 1:"."(ch), 2:"03"(word), 3:"."(ch), 4:"01"(word)
    engine = _Engine("МДК.03.01")
    # For i=2 ("03"), p=i-1=1. self.kind(1) is 'ch' and self.text(1) is '.'.
    # So p becomes 1-1=0. self.kind(0) is 'word' and self.text(0) is 'МДК'.
    # 'МДК' is in _COURSE_CODES.
    assert engine.course_code_before(2) is True
